# CANDIDATE: NARROW_ORB_VWAP_RECLAIM_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An unusually narrow opening range (volatility contraction) followed by a breakout above the ORH with VWAP reclamation and a stacked EMA ribbon signals high-probability continuation long. This edge exists because narrow ORs often precede expansion phases, and the confluence of VWAP reclamation (institutional interest) with EMA ribbon alignment (momentum) filters for high-quality breakouts in elevated volatility regimes.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If the 30-min opening range width (ORH‑ORL) < 0.2 * ATR(20) AND price breaks above ORH with close > ORH AND price > VWAP AND EMA9 > EMA21 > EMA50 (bullish ribbon) THEN enter long at the close of the breakout bar.  
**Exit:** Stop at opening range low (ORL) - 0.2*ATR(5); first target at 1.5R to ORH + (ORH‑ORL); trail remainder with an ATR*2 chandelier exit after 1R is achieved.  
**Regime filters:** Only consider when VIX > 20 and time > 10:30 EST; avoid entries during low-VIX (<12) or major news windows (FOMC/CPI/NFP).
